item.summary: refactor(ui): align sidebar session list on a single lead-slot rail (#120473) * refactor(ui): align sidebar session list on a single lead-slot rail * fix(ui): keep sidebar group drag handle interactive * fix(ui): keep catalog chevron visible on touch devices Touch contexts have no hover, so branded catalog headers keep the chevron as their resting affordance (ClawSweeper P2 on #120473).
